basic_profile.bio: CuriousMind123 is a 19-year-old university student from Toronto, Canada. They are currently pursuing a degree in Psychology and have a keen interest in understanding the human mind and behavior. In their free time, they dabble in amateur boxing and enjoy playing strategic video games like Lemnis Gate. They often browse Reddit in the evenings and late at night after classes and boxing practice. They are single and enjoy exploring various online communities to learn new perspectives.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: CuriousMind123 has a foundational understanding of Psychology from their university coursework. They also have self-taught knowledge in boxing, learned through YouTube tutorials and practice at a local gym. Their interest in subliminals stems from curiosity about self-improvement and mental conditioning.
